observation.visible_scene: An outdoor grassy field at twilight, bordered by a distant bare tree line under a gradient sky, with a circular red-brick fire pit in the foreground. The pit is heaped with evergreen branches (pine/cedar boughs), and a bright orange-yellow flame burns from the center of the pile.
visible_changes: The central flame flickers continuously, its shape and height varying frame to frame—sometimes a tall narrow column, sometimes a bushier, split plume with tongues of fire reaching higher into the air.
The flame's base remains anchored in the same spot within the branch pile, while its upper portions billow, lean, and re-form.
The surrounding greenery, brick pit, field, and tree line stay fixed in position, indicating no significant camera movement and no large-scale change in the fuel pile during the excerpt.
outside_clip_unknowns: How the fire was ignited and whether the fuel is being visibly consumed over a longer timescale.
The wind conditions and the eventual outcome of the burn beyond this short segment.
uncertain_details: Whether the fire is overall growing or diminishing cannot be determined from this brief excerpt.
Subtle shifts in the branch pile, if any, are not clearly distinguishable from the flame's motion.
